otp.description:
OTPKey is the secret key used to generate the one‑time password.
example: JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP

tenantId.description:
TenantID identifies the tenant to which the user belongs.
example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000

token.description:
Token is the JWT to be used for subsequent requests.
example: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...

tokenExpirationInstant.description:
TokenExpirationInstant is the RFC3339 timestamp when the token expires.
example: 2025-07-07T20:15:30Z

user.description:
User contains basic information about the authenticated user.
Uses our local wrapper so swag can generate a schema for it.

application_id.description:
ApplicationID is the UUID of the application requesting authentication.
example: 00000000-1111-0000-0000-000000000000

loginId.description:
LoginID is the user's identifier, usually their email.
example: admin@example.com

password.description:
Password is the user's plaintext password.
example: password

accuracy.description: accuracy is the confidence percentage of the detection.

cpe.description: cpe is the Common Platform Enumeration string.

family.description: family groups this OS into a family (e.g. "Linux").

full_name.description:
Fullname of the operating system with user (e.g. "Ubuntu").
required: true

host_id.description:
host_id is the identifier of the scanned host.
required: true

id.description:
id is the unique identifier for the OS record.
required: true

name.description:
name of the operating system (e.g. "Ubuntu").
required: true

none_count.description: none_count count of items without severity classification.

scan_id.description:
scan_id is the identifier of the scan this record belongs to.
required: true

total_vulnerabilities_count.description: total_vulnerabilities_count total number of detected vulnerabilities.

unknown_count.description: unknown_count count of vulnerabilities with unknown severity.

operating_system.description:
operating_system holds the data of the detected operating system.
required: true

services.description:
services is the list of services detected on the host.
required: true
